### Background API missing badge setter **High Severity** The new `setPerpsTabBadgeSeen` action calls `submitRequestToBackground('setPerpsTabBadgeSeen', …)`, but that method is not registered on the background `MetamaskController` API alongside other AppState setters (e.g. `setMusdConversionEducationSeen`). Dismissal likely fails at runtime, so the badge may not hide reliably and `perpsTabBadgeSeen` may not persist after reload.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 297a56ae760dd73777459e094e9283e157dade60. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

Not applicable — `setPerpsTabBadgeSeen` **is** registered on the background `MetamaskController` API at `app/scripts/metamask-controller.js:3326` (bound to `appStateController.setPerpsTabBadgeSeen`). This was flagged on an earlier commit (297a56ae); on current HEAD the setter is wired up and the dismissal persists across reloads.

### Duplicate Perp Screen Viewed events **Medium Severity** Mapping the Perps overview tab to `PerpsScreenViewed` makes `handleTabClick` emit that event on every tab click, but `PerpsView` already fires the same event once loading finishes with Perps-specific properties. Users with Perps enabled get two `Perp Screen Viewed` events per visit, inflating counts and splitting analytics across Home vs Perps categories.
Additional Locations (1) - [`ui/components/multichain/account-overview/account-overview-tabs.tsx#L147-L163`](https://github.com/MetaMask/metamask-extension/blob/297a56ae760dd73777459e094e9283e157dade60/ui/components/multichain/account-overview/account-overview-tabs.tsx#L147-L163)
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 297a56ae760dd73777459e094e9283e157dade60. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

Not applicable — `ACCOUNT_OVERVIEW_TAB_KEY_TO_METAMETRICS_EVENT_NAME_MAP` (shared/constants/app-state.ts) has **no** Perps entry (only Tokens/DeFi/Activity), so `handleTabClick` fires no `Perp Screen Viewed` event for the Perps tab — no duplicate events. Stale finding from commit 297a56ae.

### Dismisses badge without Perps tab **Medium Severity** The new mount effect persists `perpsTabBadgeSeen` when `activeTabKey` is `perps` and `showPerpsTabBadge` is true, but it does not require the Perps experience to be available. With `?tab=perps` or a persisted default of `perps` while Perps is disabled, the Perps tab (and badge) are not rendered yet `setPerpsTabBadgeSeen(true)` still runs, permanently hiding the badge if Perps later becomes available.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit dc59437cc7545db2b556d46737558cf49cfa9148. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).

Not applicable — `showPerpsTabBadge` requires `isPerpsExperienceAvailable` (account-overview-tabs.tsx:119-122) and the mount effect that calls `setPerpsTabBadgeSeen(true)` is gated on `showPerpsTabBadge`, so the badge is never marked seen while Perps is unavailable. Stale finding from commit dc59437c.
Do we need a migration here?
I dont think so it's a new field

No migration needed — `perpsTabBadgeSeen` has a default (`false`) in `getDefaultAppStateControllerState()` and is merged on controller init, so existing users pick it up automatically. Same pattern as the neighbouring `musdConversionEducationSeen` flag, which also shipped without a migration.

Should this new A/B test use the threshold array JSON shape described in docs/ab-testing.md rather than { enabled: false }? I noticed at least one older A/B style registry entry uses the feature toggle shape, so I want to check the intended standard here.

The current guide says new A/B flags should store the exact production remote JSON value, including the threshold array, so E2E mocks exercise the same bucketing path as production.

Good catch — updated to mirror the exact production remote JSON in `eb67e67`: the version-scoped threshold array (`{ versions: { "13.37.0": [control 0.5, treatment 1] } }`), not the `{ enabled: false }` toggle shape. The E2E mock now resolves through the same `RemoteFeatureFlagController` path as prod (version select → `metaMetricsId` bucketing), falling back to control when no `metaMetricsId` is set.

Fixed in 6777fd61c0. The entry already used the production threshold-array shape (per docs/ab-testing.md, not `{ enabled: false }`). The remaining issue was that merging `main` produced a **duplicate** `perpsTAT3382AbtestTabBadge` key — `main` already carries the auto-synced entry (from #43788). Removed the branch's redundant copy so the canonical synced entry, which mirrors the exact production value, is the single source.
